description: §19.16.3 rules 1 + 3 (S430 round 3, H3) — a deferred call to a failable SERVER function whose server answers with a transport error (CpsError.ServerError, which is NOT in the callee's declared RelError enum). The deferred handler is total (`| _ :>`), so the failure lands in the catch-all IN PLACE and the function's own return value stands: @out = "OK" (identical to the no-defer twin `server-callee-error-total-handler-twin`), trace = "work;release-failed;". Before the fix the lowering emitted `else { return <error envelope> }` inside the `finally`, and @out became the ServerError envelope.
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 3: a deferred failable call is handled in place by a TOTAL handler; rule 1: nothing in a deferred body may transfer control out of it — so a failure the declared arms do not list goes to `_`, never propagates out of the `finally`.
